short.en: Automatically discovers SSL/TLS certificates on Linux web servers through GLPI Agent and registers them as native GLPI Certificate objects.

long.en:
Certificate Inventory is an open-source community plugin for GLPI that automates SSL/TLS certificate inventory on Linux servers.
The client-side discovery script identifies certificates actively referenced by Apache or Nginx, extracts public X.509 metadata with OpenSSL, and transports the information through the standard GLPI Agent inventory process.
The server-side plugin converts the inventory markers into native GLPI Certificate objects and automatically associates each certificate with the originating Computer.
Collected metadata can include the Common Name (CN), Subject Alternative Names (SAN), issuer, serial number, SHA-256 fingerprint, expiration date, and local certificate path.
The project does not read or transmit private key contents and does not require GLPI REST API credentials on managed client servers.
Initial target platforms include Ubuntu Server 22.04 LTS and Ubuntu Server 24.04 LTS with Apache HTTP Server or Nginx.
